identification: Mixed small lot: (1) Indian tourist carving in bone, a tapering tusk-section cylinder carved in relief with a standing female figure (devi/dancer) holding a flower, leaf canopy above, lotus base, about 13 cm; (2) three bone dice with black pips; (3) four bone crochet hooks plus one plain bone pin/bodkin with knob end; (4) a small carved bone flower cluster, probably a broken brooch or finial. Looks like 20th century, carving style is typical of mid 1900s Indian souvenir work. Material reads as bone (no visible Schreger lines), not ivory, but the photos are 450x600 so that can't be confirmed.
